subject.title: feat(session): add named new and close chat commands

question: Should OpenClaw accept chat-side `/close` and `/delete` as core session-management commands once the parser, proof, and rebase blockers are fixed?
rationale: The code defect is mechanical, but exposing destructive session archive/delete commands from chat changes the user-facing session-state surface and should reflect maintainer product intent.

options.title: Accept guarded chat deletion
options.body: Land `/close` and `/delete` after parser repair, current-head proof, rebase, and confirmation that the current main-session/admin guards are the intended product boundary.

options.title: Split destructive commands out
options.body: Keep named `/new` work but move `/close` and `/delete` to a separate PR or UI/session-management surface for dedicated review.

options.title: Pause the command surface
options.body: Close or pause this PR if maintainers do not want destructive chat-side session management in core slash commands.

recommendation.title: Accept guarded chat deletion
recommendation.body: Land `/close` and `/delete` after parser repair, current-head proof, rebase, and confirmation that the current main-session/admin guards are the intended product boundary.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged work owns the session delete lifecycle and cross-platform session-management product surface most directly affected by this choice.
